function.name: give_up
function.arguments: {"reason": "The red block is still on the table and cannot be placed in the bowl within budget: five closing attempts ended in air because the end-effector reference sits at fingertip height (all closes swept just above the block top), the wrist-camera image center is laterally offset from the jaw axis (repeated +y mislocalization), and each corrective sweep herded the block further +y. At step 842 of 900 only ~58 control steps and 2 decisions remain - enough for either a grasp or a carry, never both, so success is unreachable.", "hindsight": "1) eef_pos is at or near fingertip height: to grasp a ~4.5cm block on the table (top ~0.845) close at eef z~0.822-0.83, not 0.855-0.87; closes commanded above 0.85 swept over the block. 2) The wrist camera image center is offset from the jaw axis by roughly +2cm (and wide-angle near-field distortion grows close to the table) - never localize off wrist-image offsets; use the fixed side view for x and the front view for y, and confirm with touch. 3) move_to returns after only ~2-3 steps for xyz-only deltas, and the measured pose lags the command by 1-2cm: include an intermediate gripper target (0.5, which retains the previous latch) to buy a ~40-step window so the arm actually converges; a full gripper 0-to-1 delta buys ~80 steps. 4) An open jaw translating toward the block herds it with the leading finger; reposition at a y-clear x first, then slide across. 5) Bowl center is near x=-0.19, y=0.045; block starts near x=-0.081, y=0.05-0.08. Budget 20 calls is tight: at most 4-5 calls per phase, so align once, close once, and reserve two long-window calls for the carry."}
